judgment: The classical expectation is PDK1 UP when a HIF-1 glycolytic program is up. The WWOX-deficient neural systems show glycolysis transcripts up and PDK1 transcript DOWN in sign (organoid KO/WT CPM 0.78; hNPC TPM 3.56 vs 5.16 in the single-library CAGE table), inside the single-gene null. The edge therefore predicts the opposite of two observations, and agrees with the third system (fibroblast PDK family up, non-neural).
